name: Nebraska Outdoor Calendar (archery tag)
terms: State government site; no restrictions seen in search snippets (not checked directly).
notes: WordPress 'The Events Calendar' site: search results index '?ical=1' URLs and /event/<slug>/ pages. JSON should be at /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events?tags=archery (or ?search=archery). Lists USA Archery Nebraska State Outdoor and 3D Championships (2026 Outdoor: Jun 13, Turpin Outdoor Education Center, Lincoln), plus many classes and programs (Cosmic Archery, Archery Hike, Women's Archery) that need filtering by keyword (championship/tournament/shoot/3D). Venues have a city. The sandbox egress proxy blocked the domain, so I could not count events. Best feed found in the region.

name: OAA Scheduled Events
organization: Ohio Archers Association (Ohio State Archery Association, NFAA state chapter)
notes: Classic ASP site with an event list plus a stable per-event page pattern: /tournament/eventHTML/00106-2026-NFAA-Great-Lakes-Indoor-Sectionals.asp, 00108-2026-Marked-3D-Trail-Shoot.asp (May 24 2026, Ashland Bowmen, Ashland OH). Covers state indoor/field/3D championships, the Flint mail-in round and sectionals. Per-event pages give dates and host club/town. Probably 5-15 events a year. Egress blocked; unverified. Best Ohio candidate.

name: Ohio's Outdoor Calendar (club 3D shoots)
terms: Commercial publication, copyrighted content; reuse needs permission.
notes: Free-text calendar articles on a new URL each issue (Field & Stream Bowhunters Van Buren, Lone Eagle Bowmen Sparta, Crystal Springs, Leipsic, Wingfoot Mogadore). Useful as leads to club sites, not as a feed. The same publication has MN/MI/WI/IL/OH editions.

name: No reliable auto-updating source found
notes: IFAA events (Hoosier 690 Pro/Am in Westfield, Indiana Open/State Indoor in Evansville, State FITA Field at Koteewi Park, first Indiana State 3D Championship May 9 2026 at Koteewi, Noblesville) appear only on nfaausa.com / usarchery.org event pages (93ft platform; usarchery is off-limits). indianafieldarchery.com does not resolve. I could not find the IFAA's own site. Revisit with more searches or contact the IFAA.

name: Illinois Target Archery Association
notes: The ITAA's own site, found by search. Its format is unknown. ITAA State Indoor/JOAD (Feb, North and South sites) are mostly listed on usarchery.org (off-limits). Field Archery of Illinois (FAI, NFAA chapter; indoor state championship at Joliet Archery, Kishwaukee Archers and Rigney's) has no site I could find; its events are on nfaausa.com. Clubs with busy calendars that may have Google Calendar embeds: Kishwaukee Archers (Sycamore) and East Central Illinois Archers (Urbana, monthly 3D Feb-Sep). Not checked because the search budget ran out. ASA Illinois Pro/Am (Metropolis) is already covered by the ASA tour.

name: No reliable auto-updating source found
organization: Society for Archery in Michigan (SAM, USA Archery state) / Michigan Longbow Association
notes: SAM state indoor (Detroit Archers, West Bloomfield) and outdoor (Oakland County Sportsmen's Club, Clarkston) championships are published only on usarchery.org (off-limits). I found no site for a Michigan NFAA chapter or Michigan Bowhunters shoot calendar. The Michigan Longbow Association has one big annual event (Great Lakes Longbow Invitational, Charlton Park, August), which is not worth a feed. Michigan NASP 3D State is on nasptournaments.org (see the multi-state entry).

name: Wisconsin Traditional Archers sanctioned shoots
terms: Wild Apricot hosted site; check the site's terms.
notes: More than 20 sanctioned traditional shoots a year (WTA State Shoot at Whitetail Bowhunters Jul 18-19 2026, Stateline Summer Traditional Showdown, Blackhawk Bowhunters Fiesta, Rib Mountain Bowmen, SCWA). Hosted on Wild Apricot: if the shoots are entered as Wild Apricot events, the public event list is stable HTML and each event has an iCal download. If they are only flyers (PDF), the source is not reliable. Unverified (egress blocked).

name: Club calendars on ClubExpress (Kenosha Bowmen, Ojibwa Bowhunters)
notes: ClubExpress club sites usually have a public calendar with an iCal subscribe option, but members-only events are hidden. Each source covers a single club (one town). Low priority. The Wisconsin Archery Alliance (WAA, combined NFAA+USA Archery state body; State Field Jul 11-12 2026 West Allis Bowmen; state indoor at Viterbo University) has no site I could find. Its events appear on nfaa/usarchery event pages.

name: Minnesota Bowhunters, Inc.
notes: Statewide bowhunter organization, referenced as the contact for 3D shoots. I did not see whether it publishes a shoot calendar. The Minnesota Archers Alliance (USA Archery and NFAA state body: 18m/25m state indoor at Rockford, North Star Open/State Outdoor at Elmcrest Park, Ramsey) has no site I could find; its events are on usarchery.org. Explore Minnesota (exploreminnesota.com/event/...) lists some big shoots, such as the West Central Bow Hunter 60 3-D in August, but only sporadically. Weak overall.

name: No reliable auto-updating source found
notes: I found no site for an Iowa state archery association, Iowa Bowhunters Association calendar or IBO Iowa schedule. Club shoots are mostly on Facebook (Mohawk Archery Club, Mason City: facebook.com/mohawkarcheryclub; Visit Mason City's Locable calendar mirrors its 3D dates). Iowa NASP state and 3D championships (Iowa State Fairgrounds, Des Moines) are on nasptournaments.org and iowastatefairgrounds.org/event-calendar.

name: Missouri Conservation Heritage Foundation events
notes: The /event/<slug>/ URL pattern suggests WordPress The Events Calendar, but I have not confirmed it. Lists MoNASP State Championship (Branson, March) and the Open Outdoor 3D Archery Tournament (Mark Twain Lake, Monroe City, Aug 1 2026), along with non-archery fundraisers, so it needs keyword filtering. Only a few archery events a year. Missouri Archery Association (USA Archery state) events are on usarchery.org only. Lebanon Bowhunters (9 monthly 3D shoots) appears via a university club page, not its own feed.

name: MDC events calendar
notes: Drupal site (node URLs). It lists free 3D family shoots at MDC ranges (for example Flatwoods range, Piedmont) and MoNASP events, mostly programs rather than tournaments. I found no iCal export in search results. Egress blocked.

name: No reliable auto-updating source found
organization: Kansas State Archery Association (KSAA, NFAA chapter)
notes: KSAA events (3D Championship May 3 2026 at T.H.E. Archery Club; Outdoor Field Jun 7 2026 at Tri-County Rod & Gun Club, Linwood) appear only in NFAA news posts. I found no KSAA site. 4-H archery qualifiers are published as PDF bulletins on 4h.ksu.edu (not reliable). Kansas BHA holds one shoot a year.

name: SDAA Events
organization: South Dakota Archers Association (NFAA + USA Archery state association)
notes: The association's own events page ('Archery Tournaments & Events in South Dakota') plus news posts: State 3D in Aberdeen, State Target and State Field at the NFAA Easton Yankton Archery Center. Also handles registration. The platform is unknown; check the page source for JSON or an iCal link. Big 2026 Yankton national/world events are already covered by World Archery and the national sources. Egress blocked; unverified. Best SD candidate.

name: No reliable auto-updating source found
notes: I found no North Dakota Archery Alliance or ND Bowhunters Association website with a calendar. A few big shoots are scattered across ND Tourism event pages (NISHU Buckle Shoot & ND ACA State Indoor 3D Apr 10-12 2026; Second to Last Chance Shoot, March) and BHA (Badlands Classic 3D, Medora, Aug 8-9 2026). 4-H matches are in NDSU PDFs. ND NASP is on nasptournaments.org.

name: NASP tournament listings (state tournaments and qualifiers)
organization: National Archery in the Schools Program
terms: Not checked; ASP.NET app, check robots.txt and terms before scraping.
notes: Covers every state in this region: MN Bullseye State (Duluth), MI NASP 3D State (Lansing), IA NASP 3D (Des Moines), MO Archery Classic (Jefferson City), Upper Midwest Shootout (IN). Detail pages give dates and full venue address. A state-filtered tournament search exists on the site, but I have not confirmed how it is structured. Youth-school events only. Could be one scraper for all states if the terms allow. Egress blocked.

name: NFAA event listings
terms: Same 93ft platform as usarchery.org; check NFAA terms, which may have the same scraping restriction. Ask permission first.
notes: Many Midwest state-chapter events (IFAA, FAI, WAA, KSAA, OAA) are only published here (nfaausa.com/events/event-information/<id>). It would be the single best source for the region's NFAA state events if NFAA allows automated access. Egress blocked.

name: boisegunclub.com aggregator (do not use)
terms: Third-party site that appears to re-publish other organizations' event data; using it would be scraping a scraper. Not recommended.
notes: Shows many club 3D shoots across OH/MI/WI/MN/IL/MO/IA. Useful only for discovering club names to follow up on.
